summary: The close appeals to the whole people and to unity, not to Congress.
realLife: Four of six addresses read closed with an appeal to everyone or to unity (Roosevelt, Reagan, Clinton, Trump); one closed with an ask of Congress (Eisenhower).
sources: Read Nov 24, 2026: the first and last paragraphs of each address on the Presidency Project page; the middles were not read.
inGame: The `call` section's address-run shape speaks to groups; the close shapes are send-off and blessing. needs: an appeal piece in the close.

turns.what: The close asks Congress for a named act.
turns.pulledBy: a speaker with a law not in force
turns.writesBack: The ask becomes a bill record.

turns.what: A thank-you to the people, no ask.
